guide.summary: Gardens, cable cars, museums and the farmers' market, with breakfast spots, dinners and cocktail bars checked against their own websites.
guide.tip: Museu Quinta das Cruzes and Museu de História Natural do Funchal close on Sundays and Mondays and Mercado dos Lavradores closes on Sundays, so save a Sunday or Monday for the Madeira Cable Car and Monte Palace Madeira, which open daily except 25 December; note that Carreiros do Monte runs Monday to Saturday only.

toolkit.label: Closing days
toolkit.copy: Museu Quinta das Cruzes and Museu de História Natural do Funchal close on Sundays and Mondays, and Mercado dos Lavradores closes on Sundays and public holidays. Carreiros do Monte runs Monday to Saturday, while the Madeira Cable Car and Monte Palace Madeira open daily except 25 December.

toolkit.label: Tickets and booking
toolkit.copy: Teleférico do Jardim Botânico gives 10% off tickets booked online, and its tickets stay valid for 12 months. Blandy's Wine Lodge recommends booking tours in advance, with free cancellation up to 24 hours before.

toolkit.label: Walk-in policies
toolkit.copy: Carreiros do Monte takes no online reservations and sells tickets on site for the same day only. Galáxia Skybar needs no reservation but has a €15 minimum spend per person for non-guests.

toolkit.label: Dress codes
toolkit.copy: Galáxia Skybar asks for smart elegant dress and does not allow sportswear, flip-flops or beach sandals. The 1891 Bar at Reid's Palace is smart casual, and Rose Garden at The Cliff Bay bars shorts, swimwear and flip-flops.

guide.dek: Put Monte and its cable cars on a Sunday or Monday, when the museums are closed, and book tours and dinners ahead.
intro: Two cable cars link central Funchal with the hillside. The Madeira Cable Car runs from Rua Dom Carlos I up to Largo das Babosas in Monte, 8h45 to 17h45 every day except 25 December, at 22€ return; children up to 6 ride free. At the top, Monte Palace Madeira opens its garden daily except 25 December, from 09:00 to 18:00 between October and March and until 19:00 between April and September, with the museum open 09:00 to 17:30. Adult entry is €18, children up to 14 go free with an adult, and the palace building itself is not open to visitors.

From Monte you can ride downhill in a wicker sledge with Carreiros do Monte, who run Monday to Saturday from 09:00 to 18:00. They take no online bookings, sell tickets on site for the same day only, and charge 30 EUR for one person. Alternatively, the Teleférico do Jardim Botânico links Monte with the Jardim Botânico da Madeira, running 9:00 to 17:00 every day except 25 December. An adult round trip that includes garden entry costs €24, and booking online saves 10%.

Back in the centre, Mercado dos Lavradores opens Monday to Friday 07h00 to 19h00 and Saturday 07h00 to 14h00, and closes on Sundays and public holidays. Museu Quinta das Cruzes opens Tuesday to Saturday with a break from 12:30 to 13:30, closes on Sundays, Mondays and holidays, and charges adults €10; families get in free on the first Saturday of each month, and its gardens are free. Museu de História Natural do Funchal opens Tuesday to Saturday, 10:00 to 18:00. At Blandy's Wine Lodge on Avenida Arriaga, tours run daily and booking ahead is recommended.

For dinner, Desarma, on the rooftop of Hotel The Views Baía, lists a Michelin star for 2026 and seats guests Tuesday to Saturday between 19:00 and 21:00. Kampo on Rua da Alfândega and Akua on Rua dos Murças take reservations through their own websites. For a drink, Galáxia Skybar at Savoy Palace needs no reservation but has a €15 minimum spend for non-guests and is reserved for hotel guests on Mondays. At the Teatro Municipal Baltazar Dias, the Orquestra Clássica da Madeira plays its New Year concert on 1 January 2027.
summaryCards: Ride the Madeira Cable Car up to Monte Palace Madeira, both open daily except 25 December, then come back down with Carreiros do Monte on any day from Monday to Saturday.
Browse Mercado dos Lavradores from 07h00 on a weekday or Saturday, then pick up broas at Fábrica Santo António, open from 9h Monday to Saturday.
Museu Quinta das Cruzes and Museu de História Natural do Funchal close on Sundays and Mondays, and Desarma serves dinner Tuesday to Saturday only.

limitations: Website review, not a visit or telephone confirmation. Advertised opening, booking and exhibition details do not guarantee availability. Several official sites could not be read: Museu CR7 (domain did not resolve), Museu de Arte Sacra do Funchal (HTTP 522), Pereira d'Oliveira (connection reset), and regional culture pages for Universo de Memórias, Casa-Museu Frederico de Freitas and Quinta Magnólia (HTTP 404). Some confirmed places are published only partially: Kampo, Akua and Armazém do Sal publish no opening hours; Blandy's Wine Lodge's tour pages give tour times but not general opening hours; the Jardim Botânico da Madeira page lists weekday hours without saying whether they cover the garden or the office; The Ritz Madeira gives no exact daily times; Teatro Municipal Baltazar Dias gives no box-office hours. Il Gallo d'Oro is listed by its operator as temporarily closed for renovations, and Museu Quinta das Cruzes has announced planned building works without stating any closure.
